title: Remove the build agent's chat UI from the console and Studio (build retirement, cloud#5024)
body:
epic:#5024#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjPTfYJJKJmzZ3By7a7

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed task · Source: epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5024 — maintainer, 2026-11-26T20:06Z: 「对话组件清理也要考虑，等 build 退役后一起删」 then 「实际现在 build 已经关闭了，已经可以排期删了」; scope 2026-11-26T20:09Z: 「先删 build 的部分 可以先处理」, 「拆分组件 之后的部分先不派发」.
Grade: p2 · area:ai · domain:ui · Task · evidence: read (objectstack main 6d106a1a; inventory by the project's EE-AI discussion thread, file sizes re-measured by the seat)
Reader: seat `epic:#5024#1` → card thread.
Dedupe: open objectstack issues for `BuildDebugDrawer` / `PendingDraftsBar` / `StudioAiCopilot` → none.

## 维护者速读
- 是什么：build 对话退役后，控制台和 Studio 里只为 build 服务的前端组件（调试抽屉、未发布改动条、改动卡、Excel 建应用条、Studio 副驾等）和混在 ask 对话组件里的 build 分支一起删掉。
- 影响：只删 build 专用的界面；ask 对话、附件、审批确认、模型选择器等保持不变。build 现在已关闭，删掉不会让用户少功能。
- 要你做什么：无。

## Current state (`ui/packages`, objectstack main 6d106a1a)

**Build-only, delete whole files**
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/BuildDebugDrawer.tsx` (280) + `buildDebugApi.ts` (93) — call `GET /api/v1/ai/conversations/:id/debug` (cloud `service-ai-studio`, removed in cloud PR3b).
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/PendingDraftsBar.tsx` (152) — build's "unpublished changes" bar; the most scattered importers.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/changeCardLabels.ts` (136), `mainAreaDraft.ts` (107), `artifactStudioPath.ts` (49) — build change cards, draft main area, jump-to-Studio.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/ExcelImportBar.tsx` (257) — Excel-to-app (cloud#797). ⛔ Keep `chatAttachments.ts`'s in-page spreadsheet-to-text path: ask uses it.
- `plugin-chatbot/src/publishHealth.ts` (137) — re-exported from the core entry and `ChatbotEnhanced`; fix the exports with it.
- `app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioAiCopilot.tsx` (366) — Studio's build copilot, referenced from DataPillar, AutomationsPillar, StudioMetadataArea, StudioDesignSurface, StudioPermissionSetPage, useSurfaceDeepLink; remove the Studio side-panel entry with it.

**Mixed ask/build, remove only the build branches**
- `plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` (7,643): build parts `isProposalResult`, `resolveProposalCardState`, `resolvePlanBuildStates`, `applyBlueprintOutcome`, `ChangePlanBody`, `AppliedDraftCard`, `isBuildProposalTool`, `withoutSupersededPlan`, `isUnstructuredBuildProposal`, `classifyAssumptions`, `PublishHealthLine`, `BuildProposalProgressHint`, `selectDesignHintIndex`, types `ChatBuildProgress`, `ChatBlueprintProgress`. Ask keeps: messages, tool status, reasoning, charts, `AnswerSource`, `RecordCitations`, approval confirm, model picker, turn-alive hint.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` (3,549): `ChatPane` is exported here and used by ChatDock; drop the build hand-off, draft and blueprint-progress branches, keep ask's conversation and attachment logic.
- `app-shell/src/layout/ChatDockConversation.tsx` (492): drop the build thread bound to an app package (`app:PKG:build`) and the Builder hand-off.
- `app-shell/src/console/ai/ConversationsSidebar.tsx` (528): the cloud#1674 side-by-side ask/build history simplifies to ask.

**Easy-to-miss breakpoints**
- i18n keys under `console.ai.*` for build / publish / draft, and build strings in `ChatbotLabels`.
- `plugin-chatbot` `index.tsx` and the core exports.

## Do
1. Premise first: confirm on current main that nothing in objectstack's own runtime (OSS, no cloud) serves the endpoints these components call, so the UI is cloud-build-only; and that no ask path imports the build-only files (quoted exact-name grep per symbol).
2. Delete the build-only files and their tests; remove the build branches from the four mixed files; remove the Studio copilot entry; prune i18n keys and exports.
3. ⛔ Not in scope: splitting `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` into smaller files, approval-card or question-card redesign (the agent chat UI improvement plan follows after this card); the cloud server side (cloud PR3b, objectstack-ai/cloud#5046).
4. Changesets for every touched published `@object-ui/*` package (removed exports are a breaking change to those packages: say so in the changeset).

## Acceptance
- Console ask chat (dock and full page) and Studio still render and work; existing ask tests pass unchanged except imports.
- No remaining reference to the deleted symbols (exact-name grep over `ui/`), no dead i18n keys for them.
- Typecheck, lint and the affected `ui/` test suites green; console build (`pnpm console:build` per AGENTS.md) succeeds.

## Avoid
- Priority: epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5027 goes first. Run `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` before every push; on a textual conflict with a #5027 PR, that PR lands first. At filing no #5027 PR touched these files; open PRs objectstack-ai/objectstack#37599 and #37579 touch `views/studio-design/` — rebase over them if they land first.

## References
- Inventory: project file `ai-chat/build-ui-cleanup.md`. Parent epic objectstack-ai/cloud#5024; server-side delete objectstack-ai/cloud#5046.
